// Positive cases for the React surfaces. Scanned as a virtual .tsx path.
export function Panel({ speed }: { speed: number }) {
  return (
    <Stack>
      <Typography>Model signals</Typography>
      <Tooltip title="Reset the view">
        <button title="Close panel" aria-label="Close">
          Close
        </button>
      </Tooltip>
      <TextField label="Signal name" placeholder="Enter a name" helperText="Shown in the hierarchy" />
      <Chip label={`Speed ${speed} m/s`} />
      <Typography>{`Loaded ${speed} drives`}</Typography>
    </Stack>
  );
}
